# NBAPI 1.4.2

## Compatibility

- Fixed Moonshot/Kimi Responses-to-ChatCompletions tool conversion for request-side `namespace` tools.
- Added a global Responses-to-ChatCompletions tool conversion mode:
  - `Loose compatibility`: converts named unsupported Responses tools such as `namespace` into ChatCompletions `function` tools.
  - `Strict whitelist`: drops unsupported tool types before sending requests upstream.
- Normalized unsupported named `tool_choice` values during conversion so Moonshot-compatible upstreams do not receive unsupported tool types.

## UI

- Added the conversion mode selector to the default frontend system model settings page.

## Validation

- Added relay conversion tests for loose namespace conversion, nested namespace tool expansion, and strict-mode filtering.
